integrity: Explicit elementary-symmetric algebraic proof and exact symbolic reproducibility checks. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Theorem is characteristic-two only and concerns graded Jacobian coordinate rings, not the primary decomposition or depth or full local intersection structure. Generic multiplicity and reduced-support conclusions already follow from existing positive-characteristic derivative-locus work; only the uniform entire Hilbert series and Groebner presentation are claimed as new. Possible implicit equivalent Hilbert formulas remain an originality risk.
title: A triangular Hilbert series for characteristic-two banana graph Jacobian schemes
